content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Engineering / Technology in Electronics / Electricals / Electronics & Communications / Telecommunication / Computer Science / Information Technology or Masters in Computer Applications or M.Sc in Physics / Design / Mathematics / Statistics / Electronics / Applied Electronics / Operation Research / Total Quality Management / Information Technology; Master's Degree in Tech./Engineering in Electronics / Electricals / Electronics & Communications / Telecommunication / Computer Science; Ph.D in any of the above cited subjects Experience: 25 years of post qualification experience for Bachelor Degree, 22 years for Master's Degree, 17 years for Ph.D. Must have at least 5 years' experience in Senior Management Capacity. Age limit: Maximum 58 years (as on closing date of Application) Other conditions: In the event of selection of a candidate for appointment to the post of Director General on Direct Recruitment mode, she/he would have to resign from her/his substantive post before joining the subject post. Desirable: Thorough knowledge of Policies of Govt. of India Thorough knowledge of Corporate Management

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications not meeting the minimum requirements or not in the proper proforma with undertaking are liable to be rejected. Applications from government employees not forwarded by the sponsoring authority will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: NIELIT Director General Job Description
content_sections.text: Shall be responsible for planning, management and running of NIELIT under the overall guidance of the Governing Council; Shall be required to lead a group of professionally qualified team of IECT & management personnel at NIELIT Centres and Managers of all Institutes accredited for ‘O’, ‘A’, ‘B’ & ‘C’ level courses; Will interact with leading IT Education and Training Experts / Officers from Academia, Industry and Government; Shall be responsible for preparation of five Year Plans, Annual Plans, budget etc., of the Society and its Centres, apart from developing new education and training programmes in the emerging areas of IECT for implementation in the non-formal sector. Shall exercise such administrative and financial powers as contained in the NIELIT’s Memorandum of Association, Rules & Regulations, or as delegated to him by the Governing Council from time to time. Shall be the Member Secretary of the Governing Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The tenure of the post is for a maximum of 05 years or till attaining the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIELIT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Personal interaction Only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interaction.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates relating to qualifications Experience certificates Date of birth proof APARs of the last five years Vigilance / Disciplinary Clearance

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed proforma. Attach self-attested copies of certificates relating to qualifications, experience, date of birth etc. Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the post of Director General, NIELIT". Send the application to the Director (ABC Division), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi- 110003. Forward an advance copy of the application to the Ministry. Make sure it reaches by 11 December 2026.

content_sections.text: Candidates working in Government / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies are required to send their application through proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director General.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.meity.gov.in, www.nielit.gov.in, www.persmin.gov.in, www.ncs.gov.in) and send it to Director (ABC Division), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi- 110003, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 58 years (as on closing date of Application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-15 in the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,82,200 - Rs. 2,24,100 ).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor Degree in Engineering / Technology or Masters in Computer Applications or M.Sc or Ph.D in relevant subjects with required years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. In the event of selection of a candidate for appointment to the post of Director General on Direct Recruitment mode, she/he would have to resign from her/his substantive post before joining the subject post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not meeting the minimum requirements or not in the proper proforma with undertaking are liable to be rejected. Applications from government employees not forwarded by the sponsoring authority will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Personal interaction. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interaction.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The tenure of the post is for a maximum of 05 years or till attaining the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.
